correctness.rationale: For each nonnegative exponent, every triadic-length factor meets at most two substitution-aligned blocks; all three possible adjacent block pairs occur. The Cantor block is a palindrome with ones at explicit ordered ternary positions. Fixed-weight factor families give two arithmetic progressions in the first positional moment; equality of this moment and weight is exactly binary scattered 2-binomial equivalence. Integer intersections give the stated I_w, with gap widths 3^{nu_2(w)}+1 and endpoints separately covered. The complete proof is in RESULT.md. verify.py independently checks arithmetic k=0..11 and two-arm versus rolling-scan complete sets k=0..7; finite tests do not substitute for proof.

value.rationale: This supplies a complete exact weight-resolved scattered-binomial class description at infinitely many natural substitution scales, with explicit arithmetic progressions and overlap congruences. It computes the exact natural invariant via O(k 2^k) integer operations rather than enumerating all 3^k windows, and isolates the nontrivial impact of Cantor support gaps on moment collisions. The result is useful independently as exact benchmark data for automata/word algorithms; it does not rely on an unproved closed-form guess or require an additional downstream theorem.
